snippet.title: WILL: Follow The Light | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Set sail in TomorrowHead Studio’s debut game, WILL: Follow The Light. Solve puzzles, ride a dog sled through avalanches, and navigate a sailing boat across the northern seas. Available now on Epic Games Store, Steam, Xbox Series S|X and PlayStation 5!

Available on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/will-follow-the-light-3107ec

Available on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144860/WILL_Follow_the_Light/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_campaign=YouTubeTrailers&utm_medium=May26

Available on Xbox Series S|X: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/will-follow-the-light/9pccj927xmkf

Available on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-US/concept/10018694/

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/KbEUnJuc2D 

Developed by TomorrowHead Studio.

More at:

https://will.game
https://tomorrowhead.com
